name: x-agent
description: Eleven Claude skills that run an X account: posts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, a character counter that counts the way X does, threads cut to fit, replies, a profile score, the weekly plan read against X's own published ranking weights, DMs, an audit of your analytics export, a humanizer, and a virality engine that finds the most outperforming posts in your niche and recreates them in your voice.
